subject.title: Feature request: add prefix/list-style skill discovery to ClawHub CLI search

question: Which public registry-discovery contract should ClawHub expose for exact slug and slug-prefix enumeration?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the stable CLI/API shape, pagination behavior, and moderation visibility semantics are public product/API contract decisions.

options.title: Add explicit exact/prefix discovery
options.body: Add indexed cursor-pageable exact and prefix filters to the public registry API and expose them through explicit CLI flags or a dedicated hub-list mode.

options.title: Keep ranked search only
options.body: Leave relevance search unchanged and decline deterministic namespace enumeration for now, accepting that terminal users cannot reliably count skill families from the CLI.

options.title: Defer to broader catalog filtering
options.body: Track this under a larger catalog-filtering API plan instead of adding a narrow skill-prefix surface now.

recommendation.title: Add explicit exact/prefix discovery
recommendation.body: Add indexed cursor-pageable exact and prefix filters to the public registry API and expose them through explicit CLI flags or a dedicated hub-list mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current-history owner for the CLI and v1 API surfaces where the public contract would land.
